blocks.text: The Philippine-sponsored GlobalPort Polo Team, led by businessman and sports patron Mikee Romero, opened its campaign in the prestigious Copa La Martina tournament in Argentina with two consecutive victories against Indian- and Colombian-sponsored teams. The tournament features a competitive international field of 14 teams from around the world, including entries backed by European, American, and Asian sponsors, making the Copa La Martina a showcase of international polo talent in Argentina, widely regarded as the world’s polo capital. The GlobalPort squad features an all-Argentinian lineup composed of Mariano Obregon, Pipe Miguens, and 16-year-old polo sensation Inigo Heguy, a phenomenal young talent who […]...
